## Review gates

- [ ] Existing context, templates, workflows and tests extended; no duplicate command center or acceptance suite.
- [ ] Frozen review candidates unchanged; owners coordinated before shared-file edits.
- [ ] Synthetic/demo data only. No credentials, personal records, youth media or sensitive security details in this public PR.
- [ ] Saved means acknowledged persistence; stale-edit denial, account/team isolation, originals and drafts preserved where affected.
- [ ] Evidence distinguishes implementation tests, independent acceptance, local/emulator, staging and physical devices.
- [ ] New automation's permissions, runners, retention and potential costs documented before activation; proposed automation marked proposed.
- [ ] Film Analyzer remains MVP-required (#50); untested film/AI metrics NOT MEASURED; AI generation disabled; MVP NO-GO until acceptance.
- [ ] Shared context/sprint updated; no automatic merge/deployment/spending/live configuration/data changes or branch-protection changes.

Unchecked gates require an explicit limitation, not a fabricated pass. Approval of this PR is not deployment authorization.
